$comment: MONOREPO / WORKSPACE shape (e.g. the FDS hub). Copy to <repo>/.claude/ds.config.json and tune. 'adapter' selects a DS binding under the plugin's adapters/. Everything else describes THIS repo's layout + tooling, so the engine works on any repo shape. Without this file, the plugin's write-time hooks and SessionStart scripts no-op (exit 0) — safe to enable org-wide. See ds.config.flat-example.json for a single-app repo.
$comment_layouts: REPO-LOCAL page shells only — the ones THIS repo owns. The design system's own page layouts are declared by the adapter's `layoutManifest` and generated into `layoutsPath`; do NOT hand-copy them here. The sanctioned set a page may wrap in is the UNION of the two, and the DS manifest is the richer source (kind, height contract, nesting rules, compose-only gaps). Leave this empty if the repo uses only DS layouts.
